bb56af71: ;
 ;DGJXE12
 ;The following lines establish ^DIE variables:
 ;DIE="^VAS(393," points to the global node
 ;DIC=DIE mimics the naked global reference used in the classic LATEST 
 ;  code
 ;DP=393 points to file 393
 ;DL=1 signals this entry in the LATEST code
 ;DIEL=0 serves to initialize the DIEL array
 ;DU="" is the null scratch global reference

   undefined.
504d2a15: ;If ^VAS(393,DA,"DT") exists, set DE(1) to the 4th piece.

3d2d180f: ;If ^VAS(393,DA,0) exists, it will have already been handled.
 ;Kill %Z and quit.
2518d488: ;Write the prompt out left-justified at DL cols from margin.
9246eba4: ;Just quit

61cdebab: ;Output line, pad out to column 45. Wrap if Y is > 19 chars
 ;except if DV["F" or DV["K".
4561f515: ;No room to wrap, so call classic file man dir reader.
dbea0bc7: ;If DV["I", there's nothing to edit, so output msg & Q.
f282445c: ;Read in X; timeout if none entered, honk & set X=U.
6ee5ffca: ;Quit the Read.
bfc72de0: ;Increment DQ and remove DQ(DQ) - scratch for ^UTILITY writes.
a3deef27: ;Branch on the value of DQ.

5830f16b: ;If DE(DQ) exists, go to PR code to edit display data.; 
 ;otherwise, output line & read next response.

7e710cd6: ;If X is null and DV does not contain 'R' then go to A, else if X is null and DV does contain 'R' then go to X, else if X is null and D is less than or equal to 0 then go to A, else go to X.
aa25a962: ;If X starts with '?' then go to QS, else if X starts with '^' then call the D tag and go to ^DIE17.
01815bc9: ;If X is '@' then call the D tag and go to Z^DIE2.

da3baf32: ;If X is a space, DV contains 'd' and does not contain 'P', and the user has a default value stored for this field, then set X to that default value. If DV does not contain 'D' or 'S' then write the default value.

1a9651ad: ;If DV is not null then go to M^DIE17, else if DV contains 'V' then go to ^DIE3, else if DV does not contain 'S' then go to P. If there is code in the DD for this field then execute it. If DIC('S') is defined then execute it. If no code was executed and DB(DQ) is undefined then write the default value followed by '  _'. If any code was executed then go to V.

dadb9cf0: ;Loop through the default values in DU. For each value, check if it starts with the current value of X followed by a colon. If so, execute DIC('S') if it is defined. If DIC('S') was not executed or returned false then quit the loop.
d1562937: ;If DB(DQ) is undefined then write the remainder of the current default value after the part that matched X. Set X to the part of the default value before the colon.

ce2191f3: ;If DV contains 'P' then set DIC to the values in DU, and set DIC(0) based on whether DB(DQ) is defined and whether DV contains the quote character. If DIC(0) contains 'L' then set DLAYGO to the second piece of DV after the 'P'. If DV does not contain '*' then call ^DIC. Set X to the value returned by ^DIC and set DIC back to the original value of DIE. If X is less than 0 then go to X.
cab74a87: ;If DV does not contain 'N' then call the D tag. If the length of the decimal portion of X is greater than 24 then kill X and go to Z.

5fccbf13: ;If the second piece of DV contains a comma, X contains a decimal point, and the 5th piece of DQ(DQ) does not start with '$', then clean up X by removing leading zeros and trailing decimal zeros. If X is then an integer with no decimal portion then convert it to a number.
a86fd2bf: ;Execute the code labeled 'X'_DQ and then kill YS.

b3364bad: ;Kill DIC('S') and DLAYGO. If X is defined and not equal to the up-arrow, then store X in DG(DW). If DV contains 'd' then also store X as the default value for this field in the user's namespace.
03ef49d2: ;Write a beep and '??'. If DB(DQ) is defined then go to Z^DIE17.
30e95c82: ;Set X to '?BAD'.
